lgci-methodology.text: How was this calculated? The starting balance of £5,000 grows at an assumed effective annual rate of 5% for 10 years. 120 end-of-period contributions totalling £24,000 are added at the selected frequency. Each payment then grows for the remaining portion of the term using (1 + annual rate) raised to the time remaining in years. Final balance = starting amount grown + accumulated value of contributions. Estimated growth = final balance minus £29,000 contributed. This illustration assumes no tax, fees, withdrawals, inflation or changing returns.The annual rate is treated as an effective annual growth rate (AER-equivalent), with contributions at the end of each selected interval. The model excludes tax, fees, inflation and variable returns.
